Critics Consensus While it's nowhere near as thrilling as turtle tipping your way to 128 lives, The Super Mario Bros. Movie is a colorful -- albeit thinly plotted -- animated adventure that has about as many Nintendos as Nintendon'ts. Read Critics Reviews Christina Newland iNews.co.uk 09/18/2024 Without overplaying its hand, it hits all the major notes within the wild, inventive universe of block-breaking and Goomba-stomping. Go to Full Review Peter Travers ABC News 04/21/2023 This lively computer-animated take on the video game just opened and it’s already the biggest box-office smash of 2023. Despite lapses into dull and disposable, it’s also a godsend for parents seeking family entertainment for the 5-year-old in all of us. Go to Full Review John Wilmes Chicago Reader 04/15/2023 Among the many errors of The Super Mario Bros. Movie, screenwriter Matthew Fogel plops him and his brother Luigi into a milquetoast Brooklyn family that doubts them and disrespects their small-business dreams. Go to Full Review Sarah Vincent Sarah G Vincent Views 3d It is still the highest grossing video game movie ever with "A Minecraft Movie" (2025) coming in second. Well, it is better Go to Full Review John Stark Mac the Movie Guy Apr 5 A hodgepodge of ideas that was thrown together in the biggest fan service Illumination could give us. Go to Full Review Matt Brunson Film Frenzy Feb 12 Harmless and charmless. Go to Full Review Read all reviews Caleb Apr 24 Best video game movie I ever seen Daniel 03/08/2025 It was good. Followed a good story line. shaiders 02/24/2025 Possibly the greatest video game movie. Fatiyah 02/13/2025 Excellent Movie! We really enjoyed it so much. John B 02/02/2025 Fun movie. I loved all of the retro Nintendo references Annette D @RT35921403 01/12/2025 The Super Mario movie is one that turned out to be a pleasant surprise. I was one of those people skeptical of Chris Pratt's casting as Mario. It turned out to be forgiveable. The casting worked out, and I can't complain about any of them. Jack Black's song is hilarious and memorable. Spoiler alert: in the movie, thee writer poke fun at Mario and Luigi's accents, breaking the fourth wall, and I'm ok with it. The movie was a perfect blend of nostalgia for those of us who grew up playing the games and fresh for the new generation to enjoy. I loved the various characters, and if they do a sequel, I look forward to seeing more. For anyone who hasn't seen it, stay till after the end because there's an end credit scene. It's equally enjoyable for kids and adults. Definitely worth a watch. I call this a successful movie adaptation of a video game. Well done to everyone involved. 7/10 See more Read all reviews Read More Read Less WRITE A REVIEW EDIT REVIEW POST RATING The Super Mario Bros.
